title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan surprises Nila with expensive slippers to celebrate her achievement. Feeling lonely as his brothers are married, Pallavan urges Pandian to plan a bachelor trip.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan lashes out at Bagyaraj for coming home alone and orders him never to bring Malar back. Heartbroken by Bagyaraj's lack of affection, Malar pours out her anguish to Revathi.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya plans to expose Eshwari by mimicking her voice and speaking to Abinav. Tamizhselvi is later stunned by Aishwarya's convincing imitation of Eshwari's voice.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun's concern for Madhu grows as Shyam threatens to dismiss him. Aadhavan celebrates Pooja's birthday, but Sankar later takes her and her stepmother to the police station.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu cares for Kanmani as she suffers swollen legs during pregnancy. Swetha thanks Kanmani for nursing her through illness, delighting the family as their bond grows.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira and Lakshmi plan glasses for Kandhasamy. Kandhasamy blesses Sarasu and Kumaran on their anniversary, after which Indhira and Murugan dress them up for a day out.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian brings Saravanan and the baby home from Anjali's house. Later, Gomathi insists on taking charge of the child, despite Saravanan and Thangamayil's objections.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini questions Manoj about a misplaced parcel. Meanwhile, Parvathy tricks Vijaya into fasting for a saree as Shruthi, Meena, and Rohini record the incident.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya questions Divya's feelings for Prabhakaran, while Sandhya's mom pushes her for marriage. Later, Vetri praises Abinaya and drops her and Sudar.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi spots a snake near Mayandi as he waters the plants, unaware of the danger. She calls him 'Mama' to warn him, leaving him overjoyed to hear her address him so.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma influences the minister to support Sidharth's panchayat election bid. Later, people encourage Paraman to contest the election during his visit to Manikandan's home.
